title: Even majority influence decomposition
statement: For every natural number $m$ and every Boolean function $f$ on the $(2m+2)$-dimensional cube, the total influence of its real-valued sign representation is the sum of $\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sqrt{2m+2}$ and the error defined as the difference between that total influence and this term.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $(2m+2)$-dimensional cube
